title: Singleton Fourier coefficients and coordinate sum
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The sum of the Fourier coefficients of $f$ indexed by the singleton coordinate sets equals the uniform average over $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$ of $f(x)$ times the sum of the coordinates of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$
